title: BG not rounded with dynISF
symptom: After a few days with dynISF, BG values in Nightscout appear as floats and are not rounded. With dynISF off, values are normal and rounded.
cause: The issue is attributed to xDrip, as stated by MilosKozak: 'it's xdrip issue'.
fix: MilosKozak added rounding of incoming values in a commit: 'i added rounding of inccoming values anyway https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/3e681ef219ceb11b6a185548ef735c8e43bd97ea'.
evidence_quote:
it's xdrip issue
i added rounding of inccoming values anyway
